_note: Hand-edited. scripts/refresh.py never touches this file. Order here is the order on the page. Screenshots: python3 scripts/project_shots.py (also runs weekly in GitHub Actions).

projects.name: Assay
projects.what: Ten free, hands-on courses on building AI agents you can measure, control and trust.
projects.experiment: Can you teach agent reliability with real evals instead of demos? Every lesson ends in a lab that runs against live models, and the results are shown, failures included.

projects.name: CommsCrew
projects.what: A four-agent AI crew for the comms manager who is the whole team: it ghostwrites, routes drafts through legal and PR approvers, and publishes across channels.
projects.experiment: How do you build a multi-agent system on a real codebase without fooling yourself about what you shipped? Four specialists with structured handoffs, run as a live demo that is honestly imperfect.

projects.name: Pradhya
projects.what: A free learning site with 21 practices on working with Claude, from your first structured prompt to shipping an agent.
projects.experiment: Learning by building: about an hour of illustrated first principles, then practices that each leave you with working code you keep.

projects.name: The Grand Tour
projects.what: A travel journal of 24 stops in ten countries, with a fold-out map and a food log.
projects.experiment: Rebuilt from my camera roll: AI read photo times and places, grouped them into stops, and asked me about what I had forgotten. The Copilot Log shows how AI helped run the trip.
